paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Nazir 40b](https://www.sefaria.org/Nazir.40b.2), challenging Rava. Hyman suggests that it is an abbreviation לרב״א, meaning Rav Ashi, for one cannot say that he would challenge Rava with the refutation that [Rava of Barnish](https://www.sefaria.org/Nazir.40a.15) raised against Rav Ashi. He offers this as a resolution of Seder HaDorot’s difficulty.[^1]

notes.text: The linked passages distinguish the two exchanges. Rava of Barnish addresses Rav Ashi. Rava bar Mesharshiya addresses Rava in the consulted text, where Hyman proposes reading Rav Ashi.
